newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean brokerage firms to sell Schroder's funds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean brokerage firms to sell Schroder's funds.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Securities Co Ltd and Dongsuh Securities Co Ltd said on Wednesday they agreed with Schroder Unit Trusts Ltd to sell Schroder's beneficiary certificates in South Korea.

Daewoo would sell Schroder's Pacific Growth Fund, which would be invested in Asian countries other than Japan, while Dongsuh would sell the Schroder UK Enterprise Fund, which would be invested in British companies, the two companies said in separate statements.

Any individual or corporate investors with more than 1,000 sterling, or 1.7 million won, can buy the beneficiary certificates through the securities firms after the finance ministry approves the sales sometime in June.
